answers.reason: As a member of the central university leadership, the vice president for studies is permitted to participate in central bodies like the senate.
Because funding and study programmes are treated as parts of one university-wide plan, central leadership members like the vice president for studies are involved in central budget planning.
Because appointments and teaching are part of one university-wide plan and higher office holders may take part in bodies below their level, the vice president is permitted to participate.
The vice president holds a central office and may take part in faculty-level bodies below their level, especially as the council decides on study regulations.
The vice president is responsible for degree programmes across the university and holds a higher office permitted to take part in bodies below their level.
The vice president oversees examinations across the university and is entitled as a higher office holder to take part in lower-level bodies.
Because those with a higher office may take part in the bodies below their level, a member of the university leadership is permitted to participate in faculty rounds.
The vice president is responsible for degree programmes and holds a higher office that permits participation in lower-level working groups.
As a higher office holder responsible for the quality of teaching, the vice president is permitted to take part in lower-level decisions regarding teaching laboratories.
Holders of a higher office may take part in all bodies and planning rounds below their level.
